subject: OrchardNote rebid: capacity uplift & technical validation
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@orchardnote.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: techops@orchardnote.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrchardNote rebid — early benchmark concerns and ask

Lauren / Karthik,

Thanks again for speaking last week. I wanted to flag something urgent: our internal platform team ran the competitor’s side-by-side load test last night and we’re seeing tail latency spikes once we cross ~140 tokens on typical user flows. We’ve attached a csv export from our test harness (orchard_benchmark_log.csv) — it’s noisy, but the trend is clear to our infra folks.

As OrchardNote re-evaluates for the next 12–18 months, the procurement window is open and our execs asked that vendors provide a short live proof (throughput + p95 latency targets) and a recommended uplift path if we move to a higher capacity plan.

Concretely: can Redwood run a 3–5 hour controlled benchmark under our dataset + pipeline? We’d like a short runbook and a quick tech sync to agree test details. Competitor has offered a 25% unit price at scale — we want to validate performance and cost tradeoffs before we go deeper.

Samir
VP, Engineering
OrchardNote
(Attachment: orchard_benchmark_log.csv)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@orchardnote.com>, Olivia Hart <olivia@orchardnote.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrchardNote rebid — early benchmark concerns and ask

Samir — appreciate the quick heads-up and the log. We can absolutely run a controlled benchmark and share a runbook ahead of time.

Suggested next steps:
- 30-minute tech sync this week to lock the dataset slice and sequence lengths (can you share representative prompt templates?)
- Redwood provides runbook-template.docx and a short checklist for environment parity
- We’ll run a 4-hour controlled proof (we can extend if you want) and provide token-level latency and cost breakdowns, plus an ops playbook for scaling.

I’ll loop in Karthik for commercial and Ben for uplift sizing — goal is to land a proposal with clear SLOs and a capacity uplift path if the proof shows we match throughput.

Available: Wed 09/22 11:00–13:00 PT or Thu 09/23 14:00–16:00 PT. Which works?

—Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: OrchardNote rebid — internal plan suggestions

Lauren / Ben,

Quick thoughts on strategy if we run the proof:
- Offer a six-week pilot with a temporary Dedicated pool (fixed capacity ramp) so Orchard can validate at scale with predictable latency. Pricing: temporary uplift fee + credits against first quarter of committed capacity.
- Provide a performance SLA for p95 latency during the benchmark window; include an automatic fallback plan to a smaller model variant if we observe degradation.
- We should prepare a 10%–15% introductory discount for Reserved capacity if they commit by EOY; competitor’s 25% price claim likely assumes spot-like conditions.

Collateral to assemble: proposal_draft-v2.pdf, runbook-template.docx, and a short one-pager that explains our autoscale guardrails.

I’ll draft numbers if you want me to run the price model; need expected QPS and token mix.

—Karthik

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrchardNote rebid — internal plan suggestions

Agree with Karthik. A couple concrete asks:
- If Orchard will run at peak QPS ~120 with median sequence 110 tokens, propose a temporary pool sized at 6x their average machine for the 6-week pilot. That gives us headroom for p99 jams.
- Recommend adding a one-time health-check service (ops pairing) during the benchmark window for $6k — we staff a SWE for two half-days.

I’ve updated the draft pricing in proposal_draft-v2.pdf (line items called out). If you want me to send the draft upstream to the customer, give me the green light and I’ll include a two-week signoff window.

—Ben

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@orchardnote.com>, Olivia Hart <olivia@orchardnote.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed pilot & uplift plan (attached)

Samir / Olivia — attaching proposal_draft-v2.pdf with the pilot outline we discussed:
- 6-week Dedicated pilot (temporary capacity pool) with p95 latency target and token-level analytics
- Ops pairing (two half-days) during the benchmark window
- Pricing: one-time uplift + credit toward Q1 Reserved commitment; 10% EOY reserved discount if they sign within two weeks of pilot close

Technical notes: we’ll need representative prompt templates and a dataset slice (JSONL) for parity. I’ve proposed Wed 09/23 14:00 PT for the tech sync and benchmark kickoff. Please confirm timing and share the dataset link or samples.

If this looks good I’ll open a DocuSign envelope (link included below) once you confirm.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: proposal_draft-v2.pdf)
(Links: https://docusign.net/ORCH-4521)

From: Olivia Hart <olivia@orchardnote.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@orchardnote.com>, techops@orchardnote.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot & uplift plan (attached)

Thanks Lauren — Wed 09/23 14:00 PT works for the tech sync. Attaching a cleaner extract from our harness (orchard_benchmark_log.csv) and a short note from our infra team. A couple of technical asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will run the proof against the quantized variant we discussed or the full fp16 path? We need comparable model semantics.
- We have a maintenance blackout Mon 09/28 00:00–06:00 PT that will affect extended runs.

If you can confirm the model variant and slot, we’ll share the dataset slice ahead of the call.

—Olivia
Engineering Manager, Platform
OrchardNote
(Attachment: orchard_benchmark_log.csv)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia@orchardnote.com>, Samir Patel <samir@orchardnote.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot & uplift plan — confirmed next steps

Olivia / Samir — thanks, confirmed for Wed 09/23 14:00 PT. Quick answers and next steps: 
- We’ll run the controlled proof in fp16 by default; we can also run a short quantized pass for parity comparison during the same window. Please indicate which model checkpoint you want mirrored (send the exact repo tag).
- Noted the maintenance blackout on 09/28 — we won’t schedule benchmark work in that window.
- I’ve opened the DocuSign envelope (https://docusign.net/ORCH-4521) with the pilot terms and the two-week signature window; Ben and Karthik will follow on pricing and ops details during the call.

Agenda for Wed’s tech sync (15–20 min):
1) Confirm dataset slice and prompt templates
2) Agree model checkpoint and quantization pass order
3) Validate target QPS / expected token mix
4) Schedule exact benchmark start time and ops pairing shifts

Looking forward to it — will push the call invite now.

—Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
